This is a preview release. v0.8.3-beta.2 resolved the Windows startup crash; this one adds a host name fix and covers what beta.2 left unverified.

**Install this one on both computers**: the name comes from whichever host advertises it, so updating only one of them shows no difference.

### Fixed

- **After a restart a computer advertised its machine name again**: a rename updated the advertised record at the moment it was made and no later, so starting up again went back to the system's machine name — on macOS the hostname, ending in `.local` — and never corrected itself. A host that has not paired with this one has nothing but that record to go by, so it listed the computer under a name its user had already replaced. Startup now follows the same rule a rename does: the name you chose when there is one, the machine name otherwise.

- **Windows: the app vanished a few seconds after opening** (carried over from beta.2): Tauri builds every window in its configuration before it calls MuxSU's own startup routine, and a window starts asking the backend for data as soon as it is built — while the shared state those requests need did not exist yet. All three windows are now built by the startup routine, after that state is in place.

### What this release needs confirmed

beta.2 only proved the main window opens. The window change above also affects the two windows that normally stay hidden, so please check them too:

- Bring up the host switcher with the global shortcut.
- Switch once from the tray (menu bar on macOS) and confirm the small notice window appears.
- In the list of other hosts on the network, confirm the other computer shows the name you gave it.

### Known limitations

- A preview release is never treated as the newest version by the updater, so computers on a stable release will not be upgraded to it automatically.
- The macOS DMG is ad-hoc signed and not notarized with an Apple Developer ID, so Gatekeeper may ask for it to be allowed by hand.

This version speaks the same protocol as v0.8.2 and pairs and switches with it directly.
